check.notes: Clean white seamless backdrop, no text anywhere. Right ~15% and bottom ~5% are empty white. Minor render oddities: the ribbon emerging from the handbag handle has no plausible anchor point (it just morphs out of the strap), and the box's left front face edge is slightly soft/warped near 12% x, 75% y. Box face is largely obscured by ribbon — the clearest uninterrupted dark panel for a logo is roughly x 38-50%, y 70-85%.

issues.what: Huge dead white gap: artwork ends ~48% height, caption at 94% — unbalanced, reference fills frame
issues.fix_in_canva: Scale the gift-box image group up ~1.6x and move down so it ends near y=78%

issues.what: Handbag is clipped by the top edge; reference shoe has clear top margin
issues.fix_in_canva: Drag the bag/ribbon group down ~140px so the bag top sits inside the frame

issues.what: Headline mixes serif (THE GIFTS COME) with bold sans (WRAPPED); reference lockup is one typeface
issues.fix_in_canva: Set all four headline words in bold Poppins, or all in the serif — pick one

issues.what: Straight horizontal cut across cutout shadow under box — visible image box edge
issues.fix_in_canva: Erase/feather the bottom shadow edge, or apply a soft bottom fade to the cutout

issues.what: Ribbon tails from bag strap float; join into the bow reads broken, not poured
issues.fix_in_canva: Overlap the ribbon tail layer onto the bow by ~40px and nudge horizontally to align

issues.what: No accent colour in headline; reference uses red THE/EATS to build hierarchy
issues.fix_in_canva: Colour THE and COME in Kapruka gold #FFD21E over white, or lighter purple

issues.what: Bag and box lighting/scale mismatch; bag reads oversized next to small box
issues.fix_in_canva: Reduce bag layer ~15% and add matching soft shadow beneath it

issues.what: WRAPPED right edge sits ~95px from frame; GIFTS ends ~135px — ragged right
issues.fix_in_canva: Right-align GIFTS and WRAPPED to one guide at x=980

strengths: Correct single Kapruka logo, undistorted, on brand packaging
Support line is direct, legible, high contrast
Purple/gold palette is on brand and consistent
